description: This is a shell script primarily designed to test the functionality of the 'git checkout --orphan' command in various scenarios. It sets up test cases, executes git commands, and validates expected behaviors related to creating orphan branches.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands and verifies success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the preceding command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock to simulate time passage between commits.

methods.name: test_cmp_config
methods.description: Compares git configuration values against expected defaults or specified values.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the output of commands or files to expected contents.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
